message.subject: Quick favor
message.excerpt: Are you available? I need gift cards purchased as soon as possible. I'll reimburse you. Reply to me here.

findings.title: Money request with warning signs
evidence: Money-related wording ("gift cards") combined with a different reply address
findings.lesson: Requests to move money or change bank details need a second channel. Call the person on a number you already have.

findings.title: Free mailbox using an authority title
evidence: "Andre (Director)" writes from yahoo[.]com while using the title 'director'
findings.lesson: IT, payroll and HR don't write from free mailboxes. A title in the name proves nothing.

findings.title: Replies go to a different domain
evidence: From yahoo[.]com but replies go to proton[.]me
findings.lesson: Look at where a reply would actually land. If it isn't the sender's own domain, the person writing may not be who they say.
